questions.questionTextEn: Daily weather map showing isobars is an example of :
questions.questionTextHi: [I.A.S. (Pre) 1997] Daily weather map showing isobars is an example of :
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (B) Isopleth map. An Isopleth map generalizes and simplifies data with continuous distribution. It shows the data as the third dimension on the map. Thus, isopleth maps are more common for mapping surface elevation, amounts of precipitation, atmospheric pressure and numerous other measurement that can be viewed statistically as a third dimension. [I.A.S. (Pre) 1997]

questions.questionTextEn: What is the most accurate method of representing relief features?
questions.questionTextHi: [Jharkhand P.C.S. (Pre) 2013] What is the most accurate method of representing relief features?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (A) Contours. Contours are an effective device for representing relief on topographic maps. They can be defined as an imaginary line connecting points of equal elevation on the ground surface. When contours are close together, they represent a steep slope, whereas when contours are far from each other, they represent a gradual slope. [Jharkhand P.C.S. (Pre) 2013]

questions.questionTextEn: The line joining the areas having the same rainfall is called :
questions.questionTextHi: [M.P. P.C.S. (Pre) 2015] The line joining the areas having the same rainfall is called :
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (B) Isohyet. A line on a map or chart connecting areas of equal rainfall is known as Isohyte. Whereas Isobar is a line on map connecting points having the same atmospheric pressure at a given time. Isotherm is a line on map connecting point having the same temperature at a given time and Isohalines are lines (or contour) that join point of equal salinity in an aquatic system. [M.P. P.C.S. (Pre) 2015]
